name: Présidence de la République de Côte d'Ivoire
description: Office of the President of the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire, head of state and holder of executive power.

name: Gouvernement de Côte d'Ivoire (Conseil des ministres)
description: Cabinet of Côte d'Ivoire headed by the Prime Minister; the government appointed on 23 January 2026 comprises 34 ministerial departments.

name: Assemblée nationale de Côte d'Ivoire
description: Lower house of the Parliament of Côte d'Ivoire since the Third Republic (2016 constitution); members elected by direct universal suffrage for five-year terms.

name: Sénat de Côte d'Ivoire
description: Upper house of the Parliament of Côte d'Ivoire, representing local authorities and Ivorians abroad; two thirds of senators elected by indirect universal suffrage.

name: Cour suprême de Côte d'Ivoire
description: Highest judicial body of Côte d'Ivoire; hears appeals against decisions of the courts of appeal.

name: Conseil constitutionnel de Côte d'Ivoire
description: Constitutional council of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the three highest jurisdictional bodies (with the Court of Cassation and the Court of Auditors).

name: Commission électorale indépendante (CEI)
description: Independent administrative authority in charge of organizing elections in Côte d'Ivoire, created in 2001.

name: Cour des comptes de Côte d'Ivoire
description: Court of Auditors of Côte d'Ivoire, overseeing public finances and accounts; one of the three highest jurisdictional bodies.

name: Ministère des Affaires étrangères et de la Coopération internationale
aliases: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

name: Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Sécurité
aliases: Ministry of the Interior and Security
description: Ministry of the Interior and Security of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

name: Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et du Budget
aliases: Ministry of Economy, Finance and Budget
description: Ministry of Economy, Finance and Budget of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

name: Ministère de la Justice et des Droits de l'Homme
aliases: Ministry of Justice and Human Rights
description: Ministry of Justice and Human Rights of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

name: Ministère de la Défense
description: Ministry of Defence of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

key_people.title: Minister of State, Minister of Defence
key_people.name: Téné Birahima Ouattara

name: Ministère de la Santé, de l'Hygiène publique et de la Couverture maladie universelle
aliases: Ministry of Health and Public Hygiene
description: Ministry of Health and Public Hygiene of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

name: Ministère de l'Éducation nationale et de l'Alphabétisation
aliases: Ministry of National Education and Literacy
description: Ministry of National Education and Literacy of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

name: Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur et de la Recherche scientifique
aliases: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
description: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

name: Ministère de l'Agriculture, du Développement rural et des Productions vivrières
aliases: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development
description: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

name: Ministère des Mines, du Pétrole et de l'Énergie
aliases: Ministry of Mines, Petroleum and Energy
description: Ministry of Mines, Petroleum and Energy of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

name: Ministère de l'Économie numérique et des Entreprises publiques
aliases: Ministry of Digital Economy and Public Enterprises
description: Ministry of Digital Economy and Public Enterprises of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

name: Ministère de l'Environnement et de la Transition écologique
aliases: Ministry of Environment and Ecological Transition
description: Ministry of Environment and Ecological Transition of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

name: Ministère de la Fonction publique et de la Modernisation de l'administration
aliases: Ministry of Public Service and Administrative Modernisation
description: Ministry of Public Service and Administrative Modernisation of Côte d'Ivoire, one of the 34 ministerial departments of the government formed on 23 January 2026.

name: Office national de l'état civil et de l'identification (ONECI)
description: National office in charge of civil status records and identification in Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Office national de la protection civile (ONPC)
description: National office for civil protection (emergency and disaster response) of Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Agence ivoirienne des routes (AGEROUTE)
description: Roads agency in charge of the planning, maintenance and road safety of the Ivorian road network, created in 1997.

name: Centre de promotion des investissements en Côte d'Ivoire (CEPICI)
description: One-stop investment promotion centre of Côte d'Ivoire, created in 1993.

name: Conseil du coton et de l'anacarde (CCA)
description: Cotton and cashmere regulatory council of Côte d'Ivoire, created in 2013.

name: Conseil hévéa-palmier à huile (CHPPH)
description: Rubber and oil palm regulatory council of Côte d'Ivoire, created in 2017.

name: PETROCI Holding
aliases: Société nationale d'opérations pétrolières de la Côte d'Ivoire
description: National petroleum company of Côte d'Ivoire, active in exploration, production and distribution of hydrocarbons.

name: SODEMI (Société pour le Développement Minier de la Côte d'Ivoire)
description: State-owned mining development company of Côte d'Ivoire, created on 22 March 1962; technical arm of the State in the mining sector under the supervision of the Ministry of Mines, Petroleum and Energy.

name: Société ivoirienne de raffinage (SIR)
description: Oil refining company of Côte d'Ivoire based in Abidjan.

name: Air Côte d'Ivoire
description: Flag carrier airline of Côte d'Ivoire, founded in 2012; activities include passenger and freight transport and aircraft maintenance.

name: Port autonome d'Abidjan
description: Port authority operating the autonomous port of Abidjan, the main seaport of Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Société de développement des forêts (SODEFOR)
description: State company in charge of the development and management of Ivorian forests.

name: Bureau national d'études techniques et de développement (BNETD)
description: National bureau of technical studies and development, a public engineering and consulting body of Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Gestoci
description: National company in charge of the management of strategic petroleum stocks of Côte d'Ivoire (Gestion des stocks de sécurité pétroliers).

name: Orange Côte d'Ivoire
description: Leading telecommunications operator of Côte d'Ivoire, created in 1996 as Société ivoirienne de mobile (SIM) under the Ivoiris brand, now part of the Orange group.

name: MTN Côte d'Ivoire
description: Ivorian subsidiary of the MTN Group mobile telecommunications operator, established in 2005.

name: Moov Africa Côte d'Ivoire
description: Mobile telecommunications operator in Côte d'Ivoire operating under the Moov Africa brand.

name: SIFCA
description: Ivorian agro-industrial group created on 28 September 1964; one of the major private groups of Côte d'Ivoire, historically dominant in coffee and cocoa and active in rubber and palm oil.

name: Solibra (Société de limonaderies et de brasseries d'Afrique)
description: Ivorian brewery and soft drinks producer created in 1955, known for the Solibra brand.

name: Palmci
description: Palm oil producer listed on the BRVM regional stock exchange.

name: Groupe Prosuma
description: Ivorian retail and distribution group created in 1966, operating supermarkets and shopping centres in Abidjan.

name: Nestlé Côte d'Ivoire
description: Ivorian subsidiary of the Nestlé food group.

name: Unilever Côte d'Ivoire
description: Ivorian subsidiary of the Unilever consumer goods group, established in 1969.

name: Sania Industries
description: Ivorian dairy and food industry company created in 2008.

name: Groupe Teyliom
description: West African investment group founded in Côte d'Ivoire in 2001, active in banking, hospitality and real estate; shareholder of Bridge Bank Group CI.

name: Groupe NSIA
description: Ivorian insurance and banking group (Nouvelle société interafricaine d'assurance) headquartered in Abidjan.

name: Compagnie ivoirienne d'électricité (CIE)
description: Private concession company operating the transmission and distribution of electricity in Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Société Générale Côte d'Ivoire (SGCI)
description: Largest bank in Côte d'Ivoire by balance sheet; founded in 1962 as Société générale de banques en Côte d'Ivoire (SGBCI), part of the Société Générale group.

name: Société Ivoirienne de Banque (SIB)
description: One of the four largest banks in Côte d'Ivoire, part of the Attijariwafa Bank group.

name: NSIA Banque Côte d'Ivoire
description: Bank of the Ivorian NSIA group, formerly BIAO; one of the largest banks in the country.

name: BICICI (Banque Internationale pour le Commerce et l'Industrie de la Côte d'Ivoire)
description: State-owned commercial bank of Côte d'Ivoire; historically one of the four largest banks in the country.

name: Ecobank Côte d'Ivoire
description: Ivorian subsidiary of the pan-African Ecobank group.

name: Bank of Africa Côte d'Ivoire (BOA-CI)
description: Ivorian subsidiary of the Bank of Africa group, listed on the BRVM (ticker BOAC).

name: Banque de l'Habitat de Côte d'Ivoire (BHCI)
description: Housing bank of Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Banque Nationale d'Investissement (BNI)
description: National investment bank of Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Bridge Bank Group Côte d'Ivoire
description: Ivorian bank of the Teyliom group, listed on the BRVM in July 2026.

name: Coris Bank International Côte d'Ivoire
description: Ivorian subsidiary of the Burkinabè Coris Bank group, among the largest banks in the country.

name: Bourse régionale des valeurs mobilières (BRVM)
description: Regional stock exchange of the UEMOA member states, created on 18 December 1996 and headquartered in Abidjan.

name: Université Félix Houphouët-Boigny (UFHB)
description: Main public university of Côte d'Ivoire, on a 200-hectare campus in Cocody, Abidjan; formerly the University of Abidjan.

name: Institut National Polytechnique Félix Houphouët-Boigny (INP-HB)
description: Public institution of higher education, research and production in Yamoussoukro, bringing together nine graduate schools; one of the leading engineering schools in West Africa.

name: Université Nangui Abrogoua
description: Public university in Abidjan (Adjamé), one of the three public universities of the economic capital; formerly University of Abobo-Adjamé.

name: Université Alassane Ouattara
description: Public university in Bouaké, second-largest city of Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Université Jean Lorougnon Guédé
description: Public university in Daloa, western Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Université Péléforo Gon Coulibaly
description: Public university in Korhogo, northern Côte d'Ivoire, created in 2012.

name: Université de Man
description: Public university in Man, western Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Université de San Pedro
description: Public university in San Pedro, south-western Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Université de Bondoukou
description: Public university in Bondoukou, north-eastern Côte d'Ivoire, created in 2023.

name: Université des Lagunes
description: Public university in Abidjan created in 2010.

name: Université Virtuelle de Côte d'Ivoire (UVCI)
description: Virtual (online) public university of Côte d'Ivoire created in 2015.

name: École Normale Supérieure d'Abidjan
description: Teacher training higher education school in Abidjan, founded in 1964.

name: École Supérieure Africaine des Technologies de l'Information et de la Communication (ESATIC)
description: African graduate school of information and communication technologies, created in 2016.

name: Centre Ivoirien de Recherches Économiques et Sociales (CIRES)
description: Ivorian centre for economic and social research, affiliated with the Université Félix Houphouët-Boigny.

name: Centre National de Recherche Agronomique (CNRA)
description: National agronomic research centre of Côte d'Ivoire, created in 1998.

name: Institut Pasteur de Côte d'Ivoire
description: Biomedical research and public health institute in Abidjan, created in 1972, member of the Pasteur Network.

name: Radiodiffusion Télévision Ivoirienne (RTI)
description: Public broadcasting group of Côte d'Ivoire created on 26 October 1962; capital held exclusively by the Ivorian State; operates several TV and radio networks.

name: Fraternité Matin
description: Ivorian national daily newspaper, historically the country's paper of record.

name: Agence Ivoirienne de Presse (AIP)
description: National press agency of Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Nouvelle Chaîne Ivoirienne (NCI)
description: Private Ivorian television news channel.

name: Life TV
description: Private Ivorian television channel created in 2020.

name: L'Inter
description: Ivorian daily newspaper, among the leading private print outlets.

name: Abidjan.net
description: Major Ivorian news web portal founded by the Imad Group, aggregating national and diaspora news.

name: CEDA (Centre d'Édition et de Diffusion Africaines)
description: Ivorian publishing house, major textbook and literature publisher, associated with Les Nouvelles Éditions ivoiriennes (NEI).

name: Croix-Rouge de Côte d'Ivoire
description: National Red Cross society of Côte d'Ivoire, founded on 13 October 1960, member of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement.

name: Ligue Ivoirienne des Droits de l'Homme (LIDHO)
description: Ivorian human rights league created in 1987, one of the country's oldest human rights organizations.

name: Fondation Didier Drogba
description: Foundation created by Ivorian footballer Didier Drogba, active in health and education projects in Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Fondation Children of Africa
description: Foundation created by Dominique Ouattara, First Lady of Côte d'Ivoire, active in child welfare.

name: Fondation Benianh International
description: Ivorian foundation created in 1996, active in development and humanitarian projects.

name: Fondation Franck Kessié
description: Foundation created by Ivorian footballer Franck Kessié, based in Cocody, Abidjan.

name: Agence Ivoirienne de Marketing Social (AIMAS)
description: Ivorian social marketing agency created in 1991, active in public health programmes.

name: MESAD (Mouvement pour l'Éducation, la Santé et le Développement)
description: Ivorian NGO created in 2001, active in education, health and child protection.

name: Actions pour la Protection des Droits de l'Homme (APDH)
description: Ivorian human rights organization created in 2003.

name: Mouvement Ivoirien des Droits Humains (MIDH)
description: Ivorian human rights movement created in 2000, based in Abidjan.

name: Woman Leaders
description: Ivorian NGO created in 2018, active in women's leadership and empowerment.

name: Ligue Ivoirienne des Droits des Femmes (LIDF)
description: Ivorian women's rights league created in 2019.

name: Rassemblement des Houphouëtistes pour la Démocratie et la Paix (RHDP)
description: Ruling political party of Côte d'Ivoire (presidential party); originally a coalition of the PDCI, RDR, UDPCI and MFA, transformed into a unitary party in 2018; won 137 seats in the 2021 legislative elections.

name: Parti Démocratique de Côte d'Ivoire – Rassemblement Démocratique Africain (PDCI-RDA)
description: Historic political party of Côte d'Ivoire, founded in 1946 by Félix Houphouët-Boigny; dominant party until 1999, now the main opposition party.

name: Front Populaire Ivoirien (FPI)
description: Political party created clandestinely in 1982, constituted as a party in 1988 and officially recognized in 1990; historically the party of Laurent Gbagbo.

name: Rassemblement des Républicains (RDR)
description: Political party created in 1994, historically the party of Alassane Ouattara, merged into the RHDP in 2018.

name: Parti des Peuples Africains – Côte d'Ivoire (PPA-CI)
description: Pan-Africanist opposition party created on 17 October 2021.

name: Union pour la Démocratie et la Paix en Côte d'Ivoire (UDPCI)
description: Political party created in 2001, originally founded by General Robert Guéï.

name: Mouvement des Forces d'Avenir (MFA)
aliases: Movement of the Forces of the Future
description: Political party created in 1992, led by Innocent Augustin Anaky Kobena.

name: Parti Ivoirien des Travailleurs (PIT)
description: Ivorian workers' party created on 8 April 1990, one of the first parties legalized after multipartyism.

name: Liberté et Démocratie pour la République (LIDER)
description: Political party created on 22 July 2011, led by Henriette Lagou.

name: Congrès Panafricain pour la Justice et l'Égalité des Peuples (COJEP)
description: Pan-Africanist political party created in 2015.

name: Forces Nouvelles de Côte d'Ivoire (FN)
description: Political movement born of the 2002 rebellion, historically led by Guillaume Soro; became a political party after the crisis.

name: Forces Armées de Côte d'Ivoire (FACI)
description: Armed forces of Côte d'Ivoire, responsible for protecting the population, territory and national interests; composed of the army, navy and air force.

name: Gendarmerie Nationale de Côte d'Ivoire
description: Military force in charge of policing missions, placed under the tutelage of the Ministry of Defence, created in 1960 at independence; the largest gendarmerie in sub-Saharan Africa with nearly 30,000 personnel.

name: Banque Africaine de Développement (BAD)
description: African Development Bank Group, multilateral development finance institution established in 1964 and headquartered in Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Organisation Internationale du Cacao (OIC)
description: International Cocoa Organization, intergovernmental body created in 1973 under the International Cocoa Agreement, headquartered in Abidjan.

name: Africa Rice Center (AfricaRice)
description: Pan-African rice research organization, a CGIAR center created in 1971 and headquartered in Bouaké, Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Initiative Côte d'Ivoire – Ghana Cacao
description: Joint Côte d'Ivoire–Ghana cocoa initiative created in 2018 to coordinate the two countries' cocoa policies ( HQ in Accra).

name: Association pour le Développement de l'Éducation en Afrique (ADEA)
description: Pan-African education development association created in 1988, headquartered in Abidjan.

name: Banque Centrale des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (BCEAO)
description: Central bank issuing the CFA franc (XOF) for the eight UEMOA member states including Côte d'Ivoire; headquartered in Dakar with a national directorate in Abidjan.

name: Communauté Économique des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (CEDEAO)
description: Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS), regional economic union of which Côte d'Ivoire is a founding member (1975).

name: Union Économique et Monétaire Ouest Africaine (UEMOA)
description: West African Economic and Monetary Union of eight CFA franc countries including Côte d'Ivoire.

name: Union Africaine (UA)
description: African Union, continental union of 55 African states of which Côte d'Ivoire is a member.

name: Organisation de la Coopération Islamique (OCI)
description: Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC), of which Côte d'Ivoire is a member state.
